medication.source: NO MEDS - MUM CONFIRMED BY PHONE

hobbies_interests.source: He loves trains, he can watch train videos for hours. He's very calm in water.

watch_out.source: When there are lots of people and noise, he covers his ears and starts rocking. He runs off if he sees a train. You have to hold his hand near roads.

physical_mobility.value: walks fine, runs off if sees train, needs hand held near roads
physical_mobility.source: He walks fine, but he runs off if he sees a train. You have to hold his hand near roads.

communication_learning.value: uses words, understands Bengali, has limited vocabulary
communication_learning.source: At home with his grandmother he understands Bengali too. How does he communicate? He has a few words.

emotional_social.value: calms down with headphones and train book, sensitive to crowds and noise
emotional_social.source: If he's upset he sometimes hits his head on the wall. We give him his headphones and his train book and he calms down.

toileting_self_care.value: toilet trained, needs help with wiping
toileting_self_care.source: He's toilet trained but needs reminding and help with wiping.

value.meaning: He wants to stop whatever he is doing

words_phrases.source: "He has a few words. Choo-choo means he wants the train."; "If he says finish, he wants to stop whatever he is doing."

value.behaviour: hits his head on the wall
value.control_measures: give him his headphones and his train book

challenging_behaviours.source: "If he's upset he sometimes hits his head on the wall. We give him his headphones and his train book and he calms down."
